votes.quote: The bug: for absolute paths, the spec says a marker only counts if it isn't the last segment. The code at `src/normalizeProjectName.ts:7` checks `index <= parts.length - 1`, which is always true. So a marker at the end of the path still counts, and the function returns an empty string.
